style: 16-bit pixel art game art, crisp hard-edged pixels, limited night palette: plum black, deep plum, violet glow, cream, sunset orange, warm orange and gold window lights, the career accent colour only on screens and small glows. Dusk City at night: a skyline made of lit window dots, a few still stars
suffix: no people, no faces, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no sunburst rays, no perspective floor grid, no scanlines, no grain, no glowing particles

assets.prompt: the night city with a golden Thai temple roof on the skyline, in the middle a tall server rack standing on a flat rooftop with rows of small cyan status lights on its front, thin cables running down from it to the lit windows of homes and a school building below, three small blank cyan chat bubbles floating above the homes

a desk at night, in the middle a laptop showing a chatbot window of blank cyan chat bubbles only (no avatar, no robot icon), one bubble marked with a small cyan tick and one with a small orange flag, on the left a neat stack of wall calendar pages with blank squares feeding into the laptop through a cyan cable, on the right a grey folder shut with a red padlock set aside, a window onto the night city

a school science fair table at night, in the middle a small trash-sorting project: a webcam on a little stand pointed down at three small plain recycling bins coloured cream, plum and orange, a tablet beside it showing short cyan bars, an open orange portfolio binder in front with a picture of the bins pinned inside, behind them a plain cream display board with only three simple drawn pictures (a bottle, a can, a paper scrap) and no lines of writing, a small cream university gate on a far hill seen through the window

a desk at night, in the middle a laptop whose small webcam is pointed at a plain unlabelled plastic water bottle and a plain unbranded drink can standing side by side on the desk, the laptop screen showing the bottle and the can in two cyan boxes with short cyan bars under them, a warm desk lamp, the moon in the window, a small orange flag planted beside the laptop

a rooftop at the edge of the city just before sunrise, a thin orange band of first light on the horizon, in the middle a laptop open on a low wooden crate, its screen showing a cyan network diagram of dots joined by lines, a path of glowing cyan tiles in front of it forking into two, one fork leading to a tower with a big cyan chat bubble glowing on its top, the other to a tower with a tall glowing phone-shaped window, a small orange flag at the fork
a vertical top-down game world map at night: five small dark islands in a deep plum sea, tiny lit windows on each island, no path, no labels
a chunky pixel picture frame, green outer border, orange corner studs, deep plum dithered interior with a few stars, empty centre
the PassionSeed flame logo as a pixel game host: yellow flame body, black face, big white eyes, holding a small mic, transparent background
the same flame host, mouth open mid-sentence, transparent background
the same flame host winking, transparent background
the same flame host, flame tips swayed one pixel, transparent background
the same flame host with eyes shut mid blink, transparent background
the same flame host cheering, eyes closed happily, wide grin, transparent background
